game.name: Karaoke Revolution Presents American Idol Encore 2 (USA)
game.desc: Karaoke Revolution Presents: American Idol Encore 2 is a game on Xbox 360 for singing enthusiasts, and of course for regulars of the American show. The title features around 40 songs, customisable avatars and an online mode allowing up to 8 players to compete simultaneously. Bonus songs are also available for download on Xbox live.
